outcome_evidence: The oven door is open at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot progressively approaches and aligns near the door through frames 30–95, with wrist_image showing the gripper beside the door edge. At frames 150–165, image and left_ego_image still show the door projecting outward and the oven interior exposed; wrist_image likewise shows the open door surface. Closure is not visibly completed. The episode ends during continued positioning, rather than after a clearly completed failed grasp or closing attempt; no distinct local failure is established.
